verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google spend gaps need resolution now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your paid social campaigns delivered all 12 tracked leads at $45.30 each — a strong result. Google Ads, which consumed the majority of the budget at $1,843.32 this period, recorded four days of zero spend in the past week and produced no tracked leads, meaning a significant portion of budget is not yet driving measurable results. We are actively investigating the cause of the Google spend interruptions — whether a budget exhaustion or bid issue — to get that channel contributing alongside Meta. Separately, your pipeline shows 80 opportunities created but zero booked appointments logged, which points to an intake process gap rather than an advertising problem; we are working with your team to confirm lead ownership and intake coverage so arriving leads convert to jobs.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all delivered through paid social at $45.30 per lead
spent on Google Ads this period with no leads tracked — being investigated now
calls driven by your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days, showing real organic demand

watch_item.issue: Google Ads recorded four zero-spend days in the past week, and its lead contribution is unconfirmed — a meaningful budget gap.
watch_item.fix: We are reviewing the campaign's budget pacing and bid settings this week to restore consistent daily spend and establish clear lead tracking from that channel.
